metadata.description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for SceneView — the cross-platform 3D & AR SDK for Android (Jetpack Compose), iOS / macOS / visionOS (SwiftUI), and Web (Kotlin/JS).

plugins.name: sceneview
plugins.description: Build 3D and AR apps with SceneView on Android, Apple platforms and the web. Three skills (sceneview, sceneview-ios, sceneview-web) plus the sceneview-mcp server.

plugins.name: sceneview-contrib
plugins.description: For contributors to the sceneview/sceneview repository only: review, test, version-bump and release commands, plus cross-platform parity reminder hooks.
